name: Elemental Transfiguration
description: When the Action Phase starts, if your team includes characters of the two elemental types corresponding to the Elemental Transfiguration and no characters of other elements, take this card into your hand, then discard it and generate it on the field, then convert 4 dice to those elemental types.
